alumnus of

  • CURIE: gmeow:alumniOf
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/alumniOf
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/organization

An organization — typically educational — a person is an alumnus/alumna of (schema:alumniOf; the inverse projects to schema:alumni). A past-affiliation relation; the structured period/role of the affiliation, when modelled, rides a gmeow:Membership. Non-functional.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Person -> gmeow:Organization

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:alumniOf from gmeow:Person to gmeow:Organization when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Person, gmeow:Organization
